capabilities: move completed tasks to an archive section at the end of the note
carry nested sub-bullets and sub-tasks along with their finished parent
archive tasks to a separate note under date-grouped headings
run archiving from the file menu without opening the note
customize which checkbox characters count as finished
extras: Supports desktop and mobile; the archive write is ordered so tasks are written to the archive note before removal from the source, with a warning if the source changed in between. Undo in the source note does not undo content already written to the archive note.
problem: Obsidian leaves finished tasks in place, so active task lists fill up with completed items that users must delete or cut manually.
summary: Task archiver that moves completed tasks, with their nested sub-items, into a dated archive section in the note or a separate archive note.
